Use case: logo-brand. Create a premium square module icon for WanX Workshop, a personal application-customization studio in a private AI desktop client. This is ONE icon asset, not a sheet or a mockup.
Style: refined tactile low-relief industrial design, ivory porcelain, champagne brass, warm paper, understated and elegant. Fixed palette ivory #fffdf8 / #f3ede3, warm bronze #8d6a49, brushed champagne #bb9563. No navy, no blue, no terracotta, no bright colors.
Composition: 1:1 square. One rounded-square ivory porcelain tile, frontal view, almost orthographic, gently softened corners, slim champagne bevel, very subtle paper/ceramic grain. Tile occupies 84% of canvas centered, balanced generous internal padding. Transparent outside the tile including clean soft contact shadow. Identical top-left diffuse studio lighting; avoid harsh contrast or plastic gloss.
The central symbol represents refining an existing application: one small thick ivory rounded-square application panel with an open corner, and a beautifully simplified diagonal champagne-metal stylus / precision editing nib crossing the open corner. A deliberate sculptural emblem with 2-3 bold readable shapes, warm bronze inset edges and one restrained metal highlight. Distinctive and balanced, not a generic crossed wrench/hammer, not a Chinese character, not a letter I. Beautiful at 46px, recognizable at 24px. No tiny details, no hairline-only symbol, no gears.
No words, letters, labels, watermarks, scenery, additional icons, app screenshots, captions, or surrounding UI. This is a real production icon candidate matching an ivory ceramic and warm metal desktop design system.
